candidates.author: Vercel AI
candidates.summary: Vercel CDN no longer caches origin responses when Vary includes Cookie . Vary tells a cache which request headers may change the response. Because cookies often contain visitor-specific values, varying by Cookie can create many cache entries that are rarely reused. The response is still served normally but isn't stored for future requests. You can identify these responses by checking the x-vercel-cache header and Runtime Logs .
